new_defects.defect: Participant over-attribution added one or more frozen symbols not named by the assertion statement or its nominated evidence.
new_defects.canonical_impact: None of these participant additions became a reviewed binary relationship or proposition; the statements were retained as claims.

new_defects.defect: The assertion omitted measurement as the trigger for wave-function collapse.
new_defects.canonical_impact: The item remained a claim and did not create a misleading graph edge.

new_defects.defect: The statement included magnetic-field and continuous-range context not contained in its single nominated evidence span.
new_defects.canonical_impact: The item remained a claim and did not create a compiled relationship.

verdict_rationale.assertion_fidelity: Independent review classified 17 of 24 assertions as FAITHFUL and 7 as PARTIAL, with no DISTORTED or UNSUPPORTED assertions. The partial findings are traceable participant, trigger, or evidence-scope defects rather than fabricated source claims.
verdict_rationale.structural_integrity: The trusted parent reuses all 41 frozen symbols byte-for-byte, contains 3 relationships and 21 claims, round-trips through the canonical model, has no dangling references, and mints no entities.
verdict_rationale.grounding_integrity: All 24 assertions are SOURCE assertions; all 25 evidence spans resolve exactly and uniquely, with zero missing, ambiguous, or unknown-participant failures.
verdict_rationale.canonical_semantic_precision: All 3 compiled graph relationships are independently SUPPORTED with precise endpoints and predicates, improving reviewed precision from the rejected SPEC-012 proposal's 6 of 16 (37.5%) to 3 of 3 (100%). No recall or completeness claim is made: 21 other assertions are deliberately preserved as claims.
verdict_rationale.abstention_behavior: There are zero uncompiled assertions and therefore a 0% explicit abstention rate. The precision gain is not produced by uncompiled-output suppression, although graph admission is conservative: only 3 of 24 assertions become relationships and the remaining 21 are claims.
verdict_rationale.cost_complexity: The experiment used exactly two calls, the same count as the SPEC-012 control, while adding a deterministic assertion-grounding gate. It consumed 22,413 tokens versus 26,142 for the control and took 30.33 seconds versus 36.464 seconds; authoritative monetary cost was unavailable. On this benchmark, the semantic precision gain and defect isolation justify the added assertion boundary.
